jobs.title: Associate Director, Telehealth Business Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Associate Director, Telehealth Business Operations

Role Overview

Virtual Veterinary Services is building new ways for pet parents to access convenient veterinary care and support through Chewy. The business spans a growing portfolio of virtual care services—from triage and advice to full telemedicine—as well as services that help customers overcome prescription-related barriers when purchasing prescription medications and veterinary diets.

As Associate Director, Telehealth Business Operations , you will lead the business operations function for Virtual Veterinary Services and serve as a key partner to the General Manager in managing and scaling the business. You will build and run the mechanisms through which we understand business performance, develop operating plans and forecasts, evaluate growth opportunities, align customer demand with veterinary capacity, and translate business insights into action.

You will partner closely with Product, Analytics, Finance, Medical, Provider Operations, Workforce Management, Marketing, Category Management, and other Chewy teams. The ideal candidate combines strong business judgment and analytical curiosity with exceptional execution: digging deeply into data, developing a point of view from imperfect information, and working across teams to turn insights into results. They are energized by making teams and businesses work better—creating shared understanding, bringing structure to ambiguity, and helping cross-functional partners align around what matters most and act on it.

What You'll Own

Business Performance Management

- Develop and maintain the performance framework across the portfolio, connecting financial, customer, product, operational, and provider metrics.

- Lead weekly and monthly business reviews, identifying what is working, what needs to change, and the underlying drivers, and ensuring insights translate into clear actions and accountability.

- Develop a deep understanding of performance by service, customer use case, entry point, product category, and other relevant dimensions.

- Partner with Analytics and Finance to understand performance against plan, diagnose meaningful variances, and connect veterinary service activity to downstream customer behavior and purchasing outcomes.

- Identify opportunities to improve growth, unit economics, customer experience, and operational efficiency and develop recommendations for action.

Business Planning & Forecasting

- Partner with the GM and Finance to translate business strategy and financial goals into operating plans and forecasts.

- Build and maintain models connecting customer demand, marketing activity, conversion, provider capacity, service levels, revenue, downstream sales, and cost.

- Coordinate inputs across Marketing, Product, Workforce Management, Provider Operations, Finance, and other teams to maintain an integrated view of expected business performance.

- Understand the assumptions underlying the financial plan and develop scenarios and recommendations as performance, capacity, investment, or other assumptions change.

- Support annual and long-range planning by translating strategic choices into operating assumptions and resource requirements.

The GM retains accountability for the P&L, financial commitments, and major investment decisions; this role provides the analysis, planning, and understanding of business drivers needed to inform those decisions.

Growth & Business Optimization

- Develop and manage the operating plan for growth across services, customer entry points, and use cases.

- Analyze customer funnels and downstream purchasing behavior to identify opportunities across acquisition, conversion, engagement, and repeat usage.

- Evaluate both demand generation opportunities that introduce customers to virtual veterinary care and demand capture opportunities that use veterinary services to resolve friction in an existing purchase journey.

- Partner with Marketing to understand the relationship between investment, incremental demand, provider capacity, and business returns.

- Partner with Product, Category Management, and customer-experience surface owners to evaluate opportunities to integrate virtual veterinary services into relevant Chewy customer journeys and assess their potential business impact.

- Identify differences in economics and customer value across consultation types, prescription categories, products, and use cases.

- Lead structured analysis of ambiguous business questions and opportunities, developing fact-based recommendations that consider customer value, growth, economics, operational feasibility, provider capacity, and strategic fit.

- Translate approved recommendations into executable cross-functional plans with clear ownership, milestones, and measures of success.

Integrated Business Planning: Demand & Capacity

- Develop and maintain the business-level demand forecast, incorporating growth plans, marketing activity, product changes, seasonality, and other key demand drivers.

- Partner with Workforce Management and Provider Operations to incorporate capacity requirements, constraints, utilization , availability, service levels, and cost into business plans and forecasts.

- Identify emerging supply-demand imbalances and assess their potential impact on growth, customer experience, provider experience, and financial performance.

- Develop scenarios and recommendations for business-level interventions—such as changes in demand generation, incremental capacity, or service-level tradeoffs—in partnership with Workforce Management and Provider Operations.

Launch & Business Readiness

- Maintain an integrated view of major launches and expansions, including business dependencies, risks, and readiness.

- Ensure launches have clear forecasts, success measures, operational assumptions, capacity plans, guardrails, and post-launch monitoring before going live.

- Partner across Product, Medical, Provider Operations, Workforce Management, Analytics, Finance, Marketing, Legal, and other teams to identify readiness gaps and ensure clear ownership for resolution.

- Establish post-launch inspection mechanisms and translate learnings into updated forecasts, operating plans, and recommendations for scaling or adjusting the experience.

Analytics & Business Acumen

- Conduct detailed, hands-on analyses using business data and tools including SQL, Tableau or similar visualization tools, and Excel.

- Independently investigate business questions, develop hypotheses, and identify the drivers behind performance.

- Connect customer and clinical activity to downstream prescription, order, and purchasing behavior.

- Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a willingness to keep digging for underlying drivers and new insights.

- Partner effectively with dedicated Analytics resources while retaining ownership of the business question and interpretation of the results.

What You'll Need

- 8 + years experience in business operations, strategy, general management, product, services, or a related field, including ownership of complex cross-functional business problems.

- Strong analytical and financial acumen and demonstrated ability to translate business data into insights, recommendations, and actions.

- Experience developing forecasts, operating plans, business cases, or similar quantitative business models.

- Demonstrated ability to understand performance at depth and identify the underlying drivers of growth, customer behavior, and economics.

- Strong execution skills and a track record of translating ideas and decisions into results across multiple teams.

- Demonstrated ability to influence senior cross-functional partners without direct authority and develop solutions that work across organizational boundaries.

- Strong written and verbal executive communication skills, including the ability to distill complex issues into clear choices and recommendations.

- A high degree of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating in an emerging business with limited benchmarks.

- Experience with two-sided marketplaces, provider-powered services, healthcare, or other businesses requiring active supply-demand management is a plus; healthcare experience is not required .

#Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Customer Service Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Senior Program Manager, VOC (Voice of Customer) is responsible for leading high-impact  initiatives that enhance the internal and external customer and team member experience while enabling seamless operational execution. This role drives the strategic pipeline of initiatives across business areas and serves as a single-threaded leader, ensuring coordination, visibility, and progress within the program you own. You will collaborate closely with senior leaders both within and beyond Customer Care and cross-functional partners to deliver scalable solutions, optimize internal workflows, and improve the effectiveness of core processes.
The ideal candidate excels at Operating in the details helping Chewy shape the future by demonstrating exceptional analytical skills to drive decisions, prioritizing initiatives, and translate insights into action. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, as this role interfaces directly with executive leadership and owns initiative prioritization. A successful Senior Program Manager is passionate about simplifying complexity, elevating team member experience, and delivering results through cross-functional influence and rigorous execution. The role provides broad exposure to Chewy’s strategy and operations, offering an opportunity to shape the future and scale internal excellence across the organization.

What you’ll do
- Partner directly with senior leadership to influence, prioritize, and deliver initiatives.
- Program manage cross-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment, ownership, and timely delivery.
- Lead recurring business reviews to showcase progress, surface risks, and share insights using data to represent your performance.
- Establish KPIs and operational targets, building roadmaps that provide accountability and clearly measure success.
- Leverage subject matter expertise and operational insights to influence decision-making, enhance collaboration, and align to shared goals.
- Establish credibility as a trusted partner by providing valuable insights and data-driven recommendations that support continuous improvement.
- Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to identify process bottlenecks and implement data-informed solutions that drive efficiency.
- Champion a Lean mindset, mentoring others and modeling a culture of continuous improvement.
- Partner with technical teams to ensure Customer Care readiness for Product Launches
- Design and implement inspection mechanisms, automation, and reporting tools that support long-term scalability and self-service capabilities.
- Build and maintain mechanisms for ongoing inspection and health of the processes within your program.
- Think creatively and strategically to develop scalable solutions that align with Chewy’s growth, while maintaining a strong focus on internal customer experience, and cost-effectiveness.

- What you’ll need
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
- Experience managing technical or data-driven projects involving cross-functional coordination.
- Proven track record of delivering large-scale initiatives within tight timelines and shifting priorities.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize data into actionable insights and executive-ready narratives.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including statistical analysis and root cause identification.
- Excellent program and project management skills, with a focus on clarity, ownership, and follow-through.
- Demonstrated ability to drive change through influence, build consensus across stakeholders, and deliver results.
- Confidence in communicating at all levels of the organization, from engineers to senior executives.
- Ability to manage ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in Customer Experience (CX), Customer Care, Product Management, Operations Strategy, Consulting, or Business Transformation.

- Experience working with customer journey analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or defect elimination initiatives.

- Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams.

- Familiarity with experimentation, benefit realization, operational metrics, and business impact measurement.

- Experience leading strategic initiatives that span multiple teams, organizations, or business functions.

- Proficiency with SQL, Snowflake, and other analytical tools, with the ability to independently analyze large datasets and develop data-driven recommendations.

In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

jobs.title: Manager, Environmental and Sustainability Program Manager III
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Chewy is seeking an Environmental Program Manager (EPM) , to support the Chewy Fulfillment Network! The EPM will develop and align standards and policies to support regulatory compliance and provide environmental guidance for fulfillment operations and construction teams. The individual will complete environmental performance analysis, establish and monitor metrics, and guide the teams in implementation of Chewy environmental standards. The EPM will work with internal and external partners that include contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key partners.

The EPM will use communication skills, environmental regulatory knowledge, especially with respect to state level regulations, demonstrated success in program management, and experience leading teams in complex and technical projects. This is a hands-on position that includes time spent at a site level, conducting inspections and audits; taking samples; providing guidance to other employees; ensuring proper waste classification; and dealing with multiple departments and all levels of employees throughout the operation. Does this sound like you? If so, we want you to apply today!
What you'll do:
- Manage and oversee local, state, and federal environmental regulations and Chewy policy.
- Develop strategic programs by integrating with engineering, construction, and operations.
- Drive an environmentally responsible culture within the organization.
- Function as a SME partner regarding regulatory agency interactions, permit evaluation and processing, and new process and technology introduction.
- Be a point of contact for environmental regulatory agencies.
- Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with regulatory requirements and Chewy standards.
- Develop environmental metrics to monitor and forecast performance.
- Conduct thorough and accurate environmental inspections and audits for continuous improvement.
- Prioritize and manage multiple technically complex assignments concurrently.
- Represent Chewy at appropriate levels with governmental agencies and throughout the company.
- Build collaborative relationships with various partners to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately.
- Compile and submit time critical reports to various governmental agencies.
- Complete thorough and accurate environmental incident investigations and associated regulatory reports and develop appropriate corrective actions.
- Develop mechanisms and tools for site EHS teams to implement environmental requirements consistently.

What you'll need:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in chemistry, chemical or environmental engineering or related field of study
- 2+ years' experience serving as an environmental technical resource, program specialist, or program manager.
- Experience with regulatory assessments, air permit evaluations and applications, NPDES and POTW requirements, and waste management.
- Broad knowledge of local, state, and federal environmental regulations.
- Experience successfully implementing environmental systems.
- Must be willing to travel up to 50%

Bonus:
- Master’s degree or equivalent experience in occupational health and safety or equivalent, preferred.
- RCRA Hazardous Waste Management Certification
- Certified Environmental Storm Water Compliance Professional
- Excellent organizational and project management skills
- Strong interpersonal skills: communication skills, strong relationship builder, solid influencing and negotiation skills, and the ability to coach at multiple levels.
- Proficient with MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
- Experience leading change in multiple site environments and the ability to influence those that are not direct reports or within your organization.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfortable collaborating with Directors.
- Experience in a fast paced, changing/growing organization.
- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability.

jobs.title: Manager, Healthcare Program Management III
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Our Opportunity:
Chewy is looking for a Manager, Healthcare Program Management III to lead a team and a portfolio of cross-functional programs across pricing, merchandising operations, and promotions. Reporting to an Associate Director in Healthcare, this role will set priorities, develop talent, improve business processes, and deliver scalable tools and operating mechanisms. The leader will also play a central role in integrating a business unit into Chewy by defining future-state processes, coordinating cross-functional dependencies, and driving implementation and adoption.

What You'll Do:
- Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for program delivery across pricing, merchandising operations, promotions, process optimization, and business integration.
- Set clear goals and priorities, allocate work effectively, provide ongoing feedback, manage performance, and create development opportunities that strengthen team capability and engagement.
- Own the end-to-end strategy, roadmap, and delivery for a portfolio of programs that improve pricing execution, merchandising operations, and promotional planning and execution.
- Lead the integration of a business unit into Chewy, mapping current-state processes, defining the future-state operating model, and coordinating the transition of workflows, data, tools, and decision mechanisms into Chewy capabilities.
- Partner with leaders and operators across Merchandising, Pricing, Marketing, Finance, Product, Technology, and other functions to validate problems, align on objectives, and resolve dependencies.
- Improve pricing and promotion mechanisms, including governance, planning, setup, quality controls, performance measurement, and post-event evaluation.
- Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate repetitive work, standardize decision-making, reduce defects, and improve the speed and scalability of merchandising operations.
- Create program plans with clear milestones, owners, timelines, dependencies, risks, and outcomes; proactively remove barriers and escalate decisions when needed.
- Establish and monitor success metrics for pricing, promotions, operational efficiency, adoption, and integration milestones; use results to adjust priorities and improve performance.
- Communicate strategy, trade-offs, program status, and recommendations to senior leaders; lead change-management mechanisms and document standardized workflows to sustain adoption.

What You'll Need:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Program Management, Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- 5+ years of experience in program management, business process improvement, pricing, merchandising operations, promotions, retail, ecommerce, or a related field.
- Demonstrated people leadership experience, including setting direction, coaching and developing team members, managing performance, and building an inclusive, high-performing team.
- Demonstrated ability to formulate and execute strategy across multiple complex programs while managing competing priorities and navigating ambiguity.
- Experience leading cross-functional business integrations, operating-model changes, platform transitions, or other large-scale transformation programs.
- Strong understanding of pricing, merchandising operations, and promotional processes, with the ability to connect operational execution to customer and business outcomes.
- Strong process-improvement and problem-solving skills, including the ability to define problems, determine root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement scalable solutions.
- Experience using data and metrics to develop actionable insights, establish success measures, monitor performance, and communicate program status and risks.
- Ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across functions and seniority levels through clear, concise, and data-driven written and verbal communication.
- Experience managing cross-functional dependencies, risks, schedules, and resource constraints to deliver programs on time.
- Experience leading change management and driving adoption of new tools, processes, operating mechanisms, or business solutions.
- Position may require limited travel based on business needs.

Bonus:
- Experience in healthcare, ecommerce, retail, pricing, merchandising operations, promotions, or multi-channel business environments.
- Experience integrating an acquired or distinct business unit into a larger enterprise, including process, technology, data, and change-management workstreams.
- Experience developing business-owned automation, analytical tools, or workflow solutions using platforms such as AI-related tools, SQL, Snowflake, KNIME, or comparable technologies.
- Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, or enterprise platform teams to determine when an existing capability can be leveraged and when a lightweight business solution is appropriate.

What You'll Get:
- A place where you can be your authentic self and grow your career. Our pet parents and partners are from everywhere--different places and different walks of life. It is what makes them unique. Likewise, Chewtopians are encouraged to bring their perspectives to deliver on our mission!
- Work in a culture that cares, with managers who value you and your career journey. Be empowered to think big, thrive on delivering results, and become your best.
- Development of meaningful connections with a diverse group of Chewtopians through Team Member Resource Groups and company events, programs, and activities.
- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, in addition to wellness programs and resources, enabling you to be your best self in and outside of work.

In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Our Opportunity:

Chewy is looking for a highly motivated, analytical, and collaborative Finance Manager to join our growing Marketing Finance team! Combining an understanding of finance, strong practical knowledge of financial statements, and using data to make and drive decisions, this candidate will be the financial and strategic partner to the loyalty membership program. The position will work cross-functionally within the Chewy+ loyalty program org by supporting a wide variety of leaders and teams (product, pricing, operations, sales, marketing, engineering, etc.), where someone with a self-starter mentality, outstanding communication, and the ability to drive projects independently can thrive and make a meaningful impact for the business. This role will focus on building advanced reporting and forecasting functions from the ground up for a new line of business, as well as analyzing and evaluating new growth opportunities to support strategic decisions and ensure business and financial objectives are achieved.

At Chewy, we believe in ownership and accountability and value creativity. We are makers and doers who thrive on the desire to drive results. We approach our mission to provide the best service and customer experience anywhere with a dogged determination and a cheerful disposition. Sure, we work hard, but we have fun, too. Of course, that's not hard to do when you get to bring your favorite four-legged friend to the office.

What You’ll Do:

•Work cross-functionally with the broader Chewy finance team, and the analytics, merchandising, product, marketing, tech, and accounting teams to fully understand the business, its customers, and overall operations in order to develop new mechanisms and efficient processes
•Effectively manage numerous projects at a given time in a fast-paced environment
•Perform modeling and analytics required to synthesize large sets of data and produce concise outputs to convey recommendations and/or conclusions to leadership
•Extract and analyze data from central databases using SQL, Hyperion/Oracle, and Tableau
•Improve/scale processes and throughput of reporting and cadence activities via automation and adopting new tools (i.e. AI)
•Recognize and propose analyses influencing business partners and finance leaders to drive positive changes in the business
•Develop a deep understanding of the economics for Chewy’s core retail and non-retail services to support pricing, membership benefits, marketing, and adoption, and other key strategic decisions
•Partner with team members and cross-functional senior leaders (Finance, Retail, Ops, Customer Service, Data Science, etc.) and lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial review and forecasting processes to identify planning assumptions for key business drivers and track performance while explaining variances to plan and identifying risks and opportunities
•Takes initiative in leading peers, team members, and business partners to help achieve business, team, and personal goals

What You’ll Need:

•Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Analytics, Accounting, or similar required (or MBA)
•5+ years of relevant experience (Corporate/Strategic Finance, Business Analytics, Financial Analysis, Ops/Supply Chain) or 3+ years for MBA candidates, preferably with an understanding of retail, ecommerce, or membership business models
•Strong analytical and modeling skills (building from the ground up), and experience in supporting business case development, forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis
•Advanced Excel skill (i.e., VLOOKUP/Index Match, SUMIFS, pivot tables, etc.)
•Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
•Ability to think creatively, self-start, work independently, deal with ambiguity, and meet tight deadlines / prioritize changing workloads
•Results-oriented mentality, highly energetic, dynamic individual with a hands-on mentality
•Experience with SQL or other database query tools

jobs.title: Associate Director Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Associate Director Program Manager
Plantation, FL – Operations – Full time – R31019

Job Description:

What you’ll do:
- Responsible for defining the multi-year supply chain strategy for Chewy.
- Lead a team that drives efforts across the organization to determine our network structure from supplier to customer.
- Evaluate options and driving debate across the inbound, fulfillment, and outbound space.
- Build metrics and models that evaluate options for inputs/outputs of network.
- Work with partners in data science to deliver the deep math and analytics necessary to answer the most difficult questions.
- Build the infrastructure necessary to deliver analysis, thought leadership, and leadership reviews necessary to make multi-year investments in Chewy’s supply chain.

jobs.title: Manager, Perishable Food Safety Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Chewy is seeking a  Manager, Perishable Food Safety Program Manager,  to support the continued growth of our Perishables Fulfillment Network! The Perishables Food Safety Program Manager will be responsible for partnering with the Perishables Site Operations team, Inventory Control, Learning, Quality, and Facility teams to manage the perishable network food safety programs. They will support the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the food safety programs in the perishable space by providing technical leadership for pest control, sanitation, good distribution practices, temperature control, sanitary transportation and other facets of title 21 of the code of federal regulations. This role will work cross functionally to perform risk assessments and provide guidance on corrective measures.  Does this sound like you? If so, we want you to apply today!
What You'll Do:
- Lead all aspects of the Temperature Control program across the Perishables Fulfillment Network.
- Identify, initiate, and propose closure of corrective actions taken.
- Provide input for preventive and corrective actions.
- Provide technical mentorship on sanitation, temperature regulation, hygienic transport, and good distribution practices.
- Conduct risk assessments for new and/or proposed activities, equipment, and products in and around the freezer.
- Build SOPs and educational materials for ongoing food safety awareness and compliance.
- Conduct internal audits of freezers to ensure food safety standards are met.
- Investigate customer complaints and food safety incidents.
- Keep food safety documentation and records accurate and timely as required by company policy and regulatory standards.
- Track important metrics related to food safety performance and report findings to senior leadership.
- Collaborate with category management, supply chain, quality, and operations teams to uphold cold chain integrity and safe food handling practices.
- Develop, implement, and maintain food safety systems (e.g., HACCP, GMPs, SSOPs) for perishable items.
- Identify, evaluate, and procure appropriate food safety equipment to support network-wide initiatives and ensure compliance with regulatory standards
- Conduct proactive and reactive food safety risk assessments across the supply chain, including evaluation of new products, processes, suppliers, and equipment
- Stay up to date on emerging risks, regulatory changes, and standard methodologies in food safety and communicate these effectively to teams.

What You'll Need:
- BS or equivalent experience in Chemistry, Biology, Food Safety, Food Science, Environmental Engineering
- Advanced MS or equivalent experience in Chemistry, Biology, Food Safety, Food Science, Environmental Engineering is preferred
- Minimum of 5+ years in Managing Food Safety Programs in distribution, warehousing, cold storage and/or manufacturing setting.
- Must be PCQI certified.
- Extensive knowledge of FDA regulations and how to apply them, specifically 21 CFR, 502, 117, and 1 specifically subpart O.
- Comprehension and practical application of risk assessments.
- Proficiency in data collection and management software (Excel, Tableau, SQL etc.).
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgement, customer focus, and vendor focus skills.
- Ability to analyze and verify record data, implement and monitor corrective measures, and to perform a hazard analysis of both commodity types and processes.
- Ability to work effectively and efficiently under pressure while managing competing demands and tight deadlines.
- Experience leading change in multiple site environments.
- Must be willing to travel up to 50%

- Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA and HSA (eligibility on the 1st of the month following date of hire)

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Chewy is currently recruiting an  Operations Manager  for our fulfillment center. This leader will be hands-on in a start-up environment and will build and maintain relationships with hourly associates, managers, carrier partners, vendors, other FC teams and various departments in the company. This individual will be someone who likes dealing with ambiguity, change, and enjoys getting into the details to drive improvements every single day.
What you'll do:
- Lead inbound/outbound activities for the FC, including receiving, picking, packing, and shipping, across two shifts
- Be a guide in providing a healthy and safe work environment for associates working on the outbound team
- Direct warehouse supervisory personnel to achieve prescribed objectives, including timely fulfilling of customer orders while maintaining the highest possible warehouse on time shipment and low shipment defects
- Ensure that all Key Performance Indicators (important metrics) are on target for the operation, such as warehouse misses, on time shipments, shipment defects, aged tasks, and production levels per hour, and cost per order line
- Engage a team of Area Managers and Operations Leads
- Drive planning and forecasting
- Leverage the Area Managers by sourcing and furthering ideas, and rolling them into the creation of improvement plans for the functional area
- Mentor, train and develop Area Managers for career progression and learning!
- Ability to develop and share standard processes across the shifts and network
- Build a positive team multifaceted that encourages all employees in the FC to guide and motivate change within the facility, adapt to the dynamic business, and stay focused on the customer experience
- Drive continuous improvement to safety, quality, cost, and delivery while growing and expanding capabilities within the warehouse
- Use the site Warehouse Management System (WMS) to optimize detailed order fulfillment and provide operational insights to improve WMS effectiveness

What You'll Need:
- A Bachelor's Degree from an accredited University or comparable experience
- 5+ years of management experience in fulfillment center/warehouse operations; prefer retail/e-commerce experience
- At least 4 years of management experience in Receiving, Inventory Control, and/or Order Fulfillment
- At least 4 years of shown experience of positively running large groups of hourly employees
- Experience with building or improving inventory management, order management, and warehouse management systems and processes
- Passion for working in a start-up environment with high level of ambiguity and change
- Strong project management and continuous improvement skills
- Metrics driven demeanor
- Customer service obsession, with desire to go above and beyond to satisfy customer needs
- Effective communicator and leader for employees, direct reports, cross-functional teams and executive leadership
- Shown ability to quickly adapt and drive the right results using data
- The highest levels of integrity and ethics!
- Must be flexible to work weekends
- Position may require travel

Bonus:
- E-Commerce experience
- Certification and/or experience in Lean Six Sigma and/or Green Belt certification

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic.
